META_START
 name: bob
 parameters: alice_id
 csockets: 0 -> alice
 epr_sockets:
META_END
^setup {type = CL}:
    csocket = assign_cval() : 0
    request = assign_cval() : 1
^prepare {type = QL}:
    run_subroutine() : prepare_state
^send {type = CL}:
    send_cmsg(csocket, request)
^receive {type = CC}:
    reply = recv_cmsg(csocket)
^measure {type = QL}:
    tuple<m> = run_subroutine() : measure_state
^output {type = CL}:
    return_result(m)
    return_result(reply)
SUBROUTINE prepare_state
    params:
    returns:
    uses: 0
    keeps: 0
    request:
  NETQASM_START
    set Q0 0
    init Q0
    h Q0
  NETQASM_END
SUBROUTINE measure_state
    params:
    returns: m
    uses: 0
    keeps:
    request:
  NETQASM_START
    set Q0 0
    h Q0
    meas Q0 M0
    store M0 @output[0]
  NETQASM_END
